# Launch Overseas Limited - Comprehensive Knowledge Base

## Organization Overview
Launch Overseas Limited (領海品牌管理有限公司) is an institutional cross-border brand management consultancy and omnichannel distribution gateway registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. The company bridges high-growth consumer enterprises with global tier-1 retail channels across North America, Europe, East Asia, and Southeast Asia.

### Corporate DNA
- Mainland Mission: 成就世界级的民族自豪品牌 (Empower world-class brands of national pride)
- International Mission: Scaling visionary consumer enterprises into enduring global market leaders
- Corporate Vision: The premier global brand management and full-lifecycle retail distribution gateway operating from Hong Kong
- Institutional Values: Customer First (客戶至上), Professional Integrity (專業誠信), Innovation-Driven (創新驅動), and Cultural Heritage / Long-Term Brand Asset Protection (文化傳承)

### Executive Leadership & Infrastructure
- Executive Track Record: Over 20 years of tier-1 international operations management, with former VP and operational leadership roles at top multinational brand management groups (Access Brand Group, Jollychic).
- National Standard Drafters: Core drafting experts for national cross-border e-commerce brand export competency assessment frameworks.
- Logistics Infrastructure: Over 15 years of freight forwarding governance operating a 30,000+ sq ft central warehouse in Hong Kong with full-lifecycle bonded staging, consolidation, and direct global B2C delivery integrations.

## Core Service Pillars
1. Strategic Consulting & Market Incubation: Comprehensive market entry whitespace audits, consumer behavioral insights, localized pricing structures, formulation audits, and GTM expansion roadmaps.
2. Retail Distribution & Digital Channel Operations: Offline retail placement into department stores, specialty retail chains, and mass retail doors alongside Tier-1 Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada management.
3. Integrated Marketing & Brand Public Relations: Tier-1 media placement (Vogue, WWD, Forbes, Elle), tiered creator seeding across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, pop-up experiential showcases, and commercial IP licensing.
4. Testing, Certification, Logistics & Regulatory Compliance: Complete management of US FDA notifications, EU CPNP registrations, ingredient toxicology audits, Hong Kong free-port staging, trademark defense, and transfer pricing tax structuring.

## Verified Track Record
- Florasis (花西子): Eastern aesthetic cosmetics global expansion across US, Japan, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Middle East. First Chinese cosmetics brand in Isetan Shinjuku (2023), @cosme Osaka flagship, and Tokyo Ginza standalone flagship store (2025).
- Spes (诗裴丝): Scalp wellness brand scaled across Southeast Asia, North America, Japan, and Europe through viral creator campaigns, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and offline chain doors, delivering tens of millions in first-year overseas revenue.
- Voolga (敷尔佳): Medical skin barrier recovery benchmark brand distributed across hundreds of offline retail doors, regional supermarket chains, and distributor networks in the US, Europe, Middle East, and Japan.

## Commercial Engagement Models
- Model 01: Full Turnkey Incubation (Base management fee + tiered net revenue share; brand retains commercial inventory title until end-consumer delivery).
- Model 02: Regional Distribution Agency (Wholesale purchase orders or agreed distributor margins on scheduled shipment cycles via Hong Kong free-port facilities).
- Model 03: Strategic IP Licensing (Upfront brand licensing royalty + percentage royalty on gross wholesale sales with minimum annual guaranteed remittance).

## Multi-Market FAQ
- Geographical Coverage: North America (US, Canada), Europe (UK, EU member states), East Asia (Japan, South Korea), Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam), and the Middle East.
- Regulatory Filings: Mandatory US FDA notifications, EU CPNP product registrations, laboratory toxicology dossiers, and localized packaging compliance handled prior to commercial export.
- Commercial Models: Turnkey incubation, regional wholesale distribution, and strategic IP licensing.
- Central Logistics Hub: 30,000+ sq ft Hong Kong central warehouse supporting bonded consolidation, sea/air scheduling, and direct worldwide B2C fulfillment.
